long_biography.plain_text:
Sehat Cruises placed Darryl-Ferdinand Szigeti's manufacturing background into an Indonesian travel business. As chief executive and a reported stakeholder, he helped oversee a locally built phinisi project designed for health and wellness voyages from Bali towards eastern Indonesia. The four-year construction employed local craftspeople and drew on his experience building several boats.

That venture followed decades of operating companies across the United States and Europe. Szigeti held chief executive or operating roles in inflatable-structure businesses, including Zodiac Hungary and Autoflug Inflatable Structures, then owned and managed Ecotent Trade. His career has repeatedly combined executive responsibility with the practical development of engineered fabric products and marine craft.
